title: Subagents
desc: Definition files are shared with the ZCode client (user: ~/.zcode/agents, project: .zcode/agents). Select one in the input box to route your message to that subagent; changes don't affect existing sessions.
empty: No subagents found. Click "New" to create one

edit.toolsSelected: {{count}} tools selected (MCP tools unavailable with a custom selection)
edit.systemPromptPlaceholder: Define the role, boundaries and rules of this subagent…
